findings.text: — re-derives the bundle's signal-map layout by hand (`Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "imas_ambix/data/maps/jt-60sa/pf_active.json"`) instead of resolving through the layout owners `imas_ambix/data/paths.py:25` (`PACKAGED_MAP_ROOT`) or `MapBundle.signal_map_path` (`packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/machine_map.py:140`); §1 moves `imas_ambix/data/maps/jt-60sa/` to `/work/projects/imas_gpu/jt60sa/maps/`, so this dangles, and §1's mechanical done-whens (`git ls-files imas_ambix... )`/`git grep ... /work/projects/imas_gpu/jt60sa`) do not reach it because the path is relative via `__file__` and the file lives outside `imas_ambix`. WOULD_CHANGE_THE_PLAN: yes — REASON: §1 must name this script among the census hits it resolves through the bundle and add it to a measure that can see a relative-path reader.

— §8's done-when `git grep -n JT60SA_ROOT -- packages` "finds no store-root key in the engine" cannot pass as written: the literal survives in the eddb.py module docstring (and the plan's own comment c-20261007T0137-eddb-doc records this docstring already points at a store root that does not exist), while §8 names only pulse_mint.py:300 as the site that retires. WOULD_CHANGE_THE_PLAN: yes — REASON: §8 must name the eddb.py docstring rewrite or narrow the done-when to the call site, otherwise the node's stated measure is red on delivery.

— §1 states "two runtime readers take the machine as an argument and resolve it through the bundle unchanged, so they need no edit: description_reader.py:237 and selene_deck.py"; opening selene_deck.py, `write_phase_description` takes `out_dir`, `phase`, decks and geometry, carries no `machine` parameter and does no bundle/store-root resolution (its `machine` occurrences are prose and a docstring), so the cited justification does not hold for that file. WOULD_CHANGE_THE_PLAN: no — REASON: the converter is reached by its caller with an explicit output directory, so it still needs no edit; only the plan's stated reason is wrong.

tests/data/test_pulse_mint.py:39 — both resolve the JT-60SA description store from `JT60SA_ROOT` with no `/work` literal, so §1's second mechanical done-when (`git grep -n /work/projects/imas_gpu/jt60sa -- packages imas_ambix tests scripts`) does not reach them, and `git ls-files imas_ambix | grep -i -E 'jt-60sa|jt60sa'` proves only that the map files left `main`, not that their readers were fixed; only the human-judged clause "re-running the census, every hit is in one of the three states above" covers them. WOULD_CHANGE_THE_PLAN: no — REASON: §1's prose already lists these test modules as census hits whose state must be resolved, so the defect is in the stated measure's completeness, not in the intended scope.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — no new module is proposed; §8's three path settings resolve through the existing single owners (discover_bundles for maps, resolve_description_store_root for store roots) rather than adding a parallel resolver.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §1's move and §9's flat-layout change both reach path-resolution sites, and the plan's edit-site/census accounts leave one second owner of the bundle layout unnamed and one unsatisfiable grep.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §8 carries an explicit interface account naming what each addition retires or why nothing can (--run retires nothing because the run is a new per-run-file coordinate; config retires nothing because it is the only view of resolved settings and their sources), §7 accounts for the mint→write rename needing no deprecated alias, and §9 adds no refusal family (reusing MachineMapError).
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan cites the machinery it extends (discover_bundles machine_map.py:182, resolve_description_store_root machine_map.py:244, MapBundle path methods, imas_ambix/data/paths.py), but its §1 account of what needs no edit is wrong for one of the two readers it names, and its §1/§8 done-when measures miss readers that reach the moved layout indirectly.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the only wrapper proposed (§5's IMASDB/bin/imas-alambic launcher) is justified in its own text: it clears PYTHONPATH (the module load injects foreign site-packages) and sets IMAS_ALAMBIC_HOME from which §8 derives every default, neither of which uv tool's generated shim does.
